Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-03T13:58Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Measured now:**
- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:5460` on `origin/main` `901e7cf13a` still declares `sortField` on `object-master-detail-form` `details[]`.
- At the pin `89cad75d5570`, objectui's `MasterDetailForm.tsx:83` says "⛔ No `sortField` member". The only `sortField` on that path is the derived one, handed to the grid (`:874`, `:1066`, `:1081`).
- So the spec door accepts a key the pinned console never reads. A clean `os validate` hides an authored override that does nothing.

**Why p2.** A declared key that the renderer silently ignores, on the published authoring door. It is the grade of the sibling `ComponentPropsMap` cards (#21464). Zero writers keep the blast radius small, but not the grade: an AI author is the reader this door misleads.

**Routing.** `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, so `domain:spec`. It is a narrowing (a retirement), so 强制条款② does not apply.

**Direction: the card's own, confirmed.** It was recorded at #21220's landing (`5937457620`) and mirrored on objectui#11396 ③.
- A `retiredKey()` tombstone on the detail entry. Its prescription names the derived sort field set.
- One ADR-0087 D2 conversion and one D3 entry. There is no staged window, because the writer census is zero.
- The texts that become false move in the same PR: the entry docblock (about `:5433`), `record:line_items`' `sortField` guidance (about `:2196`–`:2197`), and any generated reference page or pin that names the key.
- objectui#11396's mirror follows when a published `@objectstack/spec` carries it. ⛔ No objectui edit in this card's PR.

**Serial note for the claim.** `ui/component.zod.ts` is #21464's serial file, and PR #21590 is open on it. The claim reads the open PRs' file lists at claim time.

### ① Derived judgments

1. Accept-set narrowing: `ComponentPropsMap['object-master-detail-form'].details[].sortField` goes from `z.string().optional()` to a `retiredKey()` tombstone on the strict detail entry. RIGHT. At the pin, `MasterDetailDetailConfig` in `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx` has no `sortField` member (the comment opening "No `sortField` member", line 83 at the pin); the only `sortField` on that path is the derived one on the resolved entry (lines 372, 874, 1066, 1081), picked by `deriveDetail` in `deriveMasterDetail.ts` (line 540) from `SORT_FIELD_NAMES` (line 55). An authored value was read by nothing, so refusing it changes no rendered behaviour and closes the declared-but-unenforced door the card names. The entry keeps eleven live keys, which is exactly the member count of `MasterDetailDetailConfig` at the pin (childObject, relationshipField, columns, formFields, inlineMode, amountField, totalField, title, minRows, maxRows, addLabel); the docblock's twelve to eleven and the carriers test's `FULL_DETAIL_ENTRY` 12 to 11 both match that count.
2. The prescription. RIGHT on all five house conventions: the fully qualified key in backticks first; "was removed in @objectstack/spec 17 (ADR-0087 D2)"; the why-inert clause; "Delete the key." with the live mechanism named; the pinned `os migrate meta --from 17` sentence. The "removed in 17", "--from 17", registered-under-18 combination is the `page:header` `breadcrumb` precedent in the same file, applied unchanged. The six derived names it prints (`position`, `sort_order`, `sequence`, `line_no`, `line_number`, `sort`) are the same six, in the same order, as objectui's `SORT_FIELD_NAMES` at the pin.
3. Public surface: new module `packages/spec/src/data/inline-grid-sort-fields.ts` exporting `INLINE_GRID_SORT_FIELDS` and `INLINE_GRID_SORT_FIELD_LIST`.
